v0.0.5.description:
## Highlights

This release ships **Flasksanity & Kegsanity** — opt-in toggles that turn every reachable Lifewater Flask (Keen 4) and Vitalin Keg (Keen 5) extra-life pickup into its own Archipelago location check. Known-unreachable items (5 Lifewater Oasis flasks and 2 Cave of the Descendents flasks) are pre-excluded automatically, so seeds stay fillable.

Also in this release:

- ☠️ **DeathLink option** — enable in your yaml to share deaths with other DeathLink-aware games.
- 🔫 **Neural Stunner gated correctly** — now classified as progression and required for Pyramid of Shadows, the RCC gem area, and the Defense Tunnel Sorra keycard.
- ♻️ **Rule builder refactor** — internal `requires_*` flags collapsed into a single `requires` tuple, simplifying future rule changes.
- 🪟 **Per-pickup logic for flasks/kegs** — each location enforces its access rules independently.

## Install / upgrade

1. Download `keen.apworld` from the assets below.
2. Drop it into your Archipelago install's `custom_worlds/` directory (or `worlds/` if you're building from source).
3. Use the included `Commander.Keen.yaml` as a template for your player yaml — it includes the new `enable_flasksanity` and `enable_kegsanity` options.
4. Generate as usual.

| Game client (omnispeak-ap) | [v0.0.6](https://github.com/Joxtacy/omnispeak-ap/releases/tag/v0.0.6) ([latest](https://github.com/Joxtacy/omnispeak-ap/releases/latest)) |
| **Archipelago apworld** | **v0.0.5 (this release)** |
| PopTracker pack | [v0.0.6](https://github.com/Joxtacy/commander-keen-goodbye-galaxy-ap-tracker/releases/tag/v0.0.6) ([latest](https://github.com/Joxtacy/commander-keen-goodbye-galaxy-ap-tracker/releases/latest)) |

v0.0.6.description:
## What's new

### Logic
- **Cave of the Descendents Lifewater Flasks are now AP checks.** The two flasks in the secret pocket are reachable in normal play — the player must die to escape, but the pickups register first and dying through the trip nets +1 life. Previously excluded due to an incorrect note that flasks don't register on death.
- **POTGA Green Gem and Complete no longer require the Red Gem.** The Red Gem was extraneous in logic — it isn't needed to reach either check.

## Assets
- `keen.apworld` — drop into your Archipelago install's `worlds/` (or `custom_worlds/`).
- `Commander.Keen.yaml` — default options template.

## Companion releases

v0.0.7.description:
## 🌍 Commander Keen APWorld v0.0.7 — Pointsanity

This is the **Archipelago world** (`keen.apworld`) that generates randomized Commander Keen: Goodbye Galaxy seeds. The headline this release is *pointsanity*, plus a round of logic-correctness fixes.

### ✨ New
- **Pointsanity** — opt-in location checks for the 5000-point pickups, split into two toggles:
  - **Conesanity** — Ice Cream Cones in Keen 4
  - **Sugarsanity** — Bags O' Sugar in Keen 5

  Each pickup carries its own access logic (pogo / gems / level reachability).

### 🐛 Fixed
- **Quantum Explosion Dynamo completion was massively over-gated** — it required *reaching every other Keen 5 level* first. That rule is gone; QED now completes on its own merits.
- **Corrected pogo requirements** on Crystalus Ice Cream Cone 3, the Brownian Motion Inducer sugars/keg, and Security Center Vitalin Keg 2.
- **Dropped two unreachable Security Center sugars** (#9/#10) that had no in-game route.
- **Fixed POTGA flask names** so they line up with the in-game scan order.
- **WebWorld wired up**, so the game now appears correctly on the Archipelago webhost.

📖 [About this implementation](https://github.com/Joxtacy/Archipelago-Keen/blob/keen-ap/worlds/keen/docs/en_Commander_Keen.md) · [Setup Guide](https://github.com/Joxtacy/Archipelago-Keen/blob/keen-ap/worlds/keen/docs/setup_en.md)

| 🕹️ [Game client (omnispeak-ap)](https://github.com/Joxtacy/omnispeak-ap/releases/tag/v0.0.7) | v0.0.7 | Plays the game and talks to Archipelago |
| 🗺️ [PopTracker pack](https://github.com/Joxtacy/commander-keen-goodbye-galaxy-ap-tracker/releases/tag/v0.0.10) | v0.0.10 | Tracks your items, locations, and maps |

New here? Start with the **[Setup Guide](https://github.com/Joxtacy/Archipelago-Keen/blob/keen-ap/worlds/keen/docs/setup_en.md)**.
